slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Regarding the demand side, must each demand point j receive exactly its full demand b_j, or is it allowed to receive less than b_j (i.e., is b_j a required minimum that must be met, or a target that may be partially unmet)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each demand point must receive exactly its full demand or may receive less, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost, where total cost equals the sum of per-unit transportation costs (from production to station and from station to demand) plus the fixed costs of the stations that are used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to minimize total cost including both transportation and fixed station costs.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; remaining unresolved integrality issue is not a listed P0/P1 hidden slot and was handled as a working assumption.

summary: The agent thoroughly clarified the key hidden facts, including exact demand satisfaction and total-cost minimization, before stopping; no material silent assumptions remained.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
